Terms and conditions

Read these before you order. Placing an order means you agree to them.

Payment

Payment comes before the service. If you can’t pay the full price, a 50% down payment is okay. Your work is delivered once it’s fully paid.

No plagiarism, no watermark removal

Taking inspiration is fine, but copying a design completely is not. Removing a watermark without paying for removal means a ban from future commissions.

Rush orders

Rushed orders cost extra. If you can’t cover a rush fee, please be patient with the standard turnaround.

Vouches and feedback

Please leave a vouch or honest feedback after your order, whether it was free or paid.

Respect and revisions

Be polite and specific with your requests. Revisions have fees, and rude clients may be cancelled or banned.

No AI use

Never feed my work to AI tools. Reports with enough proof will result in an automatic ban.
